text: So I'm giving it a first look over, it seems there are boxes with and without dots, also many varying sizes, so that makes it a bit difficult at first, although I'm looking at box one, which has a much smaller blue box and more dots than any of the others, it actually has three dots and a much smaller blue box, so I definitely would say it's number one, I don't see another one that would qualify though.
